page.overview:
Who is Vanille's Final Fantasy XIII battle and field exploration quotes?

This is a list of lines Vanille speaks during battle and free field exploration in Final Fantasy XIII. Dialogue depends on the actions taken and the segment of the game the player is in.

Don't suppose you'll take it easy on us?

This is what happens to l'Cie? —Fight against Cid Raines.

It isn't Serah! —Second fight against Barthandelus.
